what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Planned per-tier launcher args widen the CI launcher surface unnecessarily
scenario_or_breakage: ci agentic-fix already owns --pr, --base-remote, --base-ref, and --max-cycles; passing them through agent launch-claude-ci either forces unrelated parser churn or fails argparse if parser support is missed
suggested_fix: Keep those args only on ci agentic-fix; keep build_launch_argv limited to fields the tier prompt actually consumes
